tasks.label: inspect-depth-fixture-layout
args: import { generateLayout } from './src/optimizer/layoutEngine.ts'; const order=[{id:'a',referenceNumber:'#01',name:'A',width:40,height:48,orientation:'VERT',color:'#336699'},{id:'b',referenceNumber:'#02',name:'B',width:28,height:56,orientation:'VERT',color:'#336699'},{id:'c',referenceNumber:'#03',name:'C',width:28,height:47,orientation:'VERT',color:'#336699'}]; const layout=generateLayout(order); console.log(JSON.stringify(layout.tables.map(t=>({table:t.tableNumber,paintings:t.paintings.map(p=>({ref:p.referenceNumber,w:p.width,h:p.height,x:p.x,y:p.y,s:p.sampleType}))})),null,2));

tasks.label: inspect-depth-fixture-deterministic
args: import { generateLayout } from './src/optimizer/layoutEngine.ts'; const order=[{id:'a',referenceNumber:'#01',name:'A',width:40,height:48,orientation:'VERT',color:'#336699'},{id:'b',referenceNumber:'#02',name:'B',width:28,height:56,orientation:'VERT',color:'#336699'},{id:'c',referenceNumber:'#03',name:'C',width:28,height:47,orientation:'VERT',color:'#336699'}]; const layout=generateLayout(order); console.log(JSON.stringify(layout.tables[0].paintings.filter(p=>!p.sampleType).map(p=>({ref:p.referenceNumber,x:p.x,y:p.y,w:p.width,h:p.height})),null,2));

tasks.label: inspect-identical-snap-candidates
args: const {generateLayout,isPlacementValid,snapToNearest5Mm}=await import('./src/optimizer/layoutEngine.ts'); const MM_PER_INCH=25.4; const order=[{id:'a',referenceNumber:'#01',name:'P1',width:24,height:18,orientation:'VERT',color:'#336699'},{id:'b',referenceNumber:'#02',name:'P2',width:24,height:18,orientation:'VERT',color:'#336699'},{id:'c',referenceNumber:'#03',name:'P3',width:24,height:18,orientation:'VERT',color:'#336699'}]; const layout=generateLayout(order); const table=layout.tables[0]; const p=table.paintings.find(x=>x.referenceNumber==='#02'); const others=table.paintings.filter(x=>x.id!==p.id); const base=snapToNearest5Mm(p.x); const step=5/MM_PER_INCH; const cands=[base,base-step,base+step,base-step*2,base+step*2]; console.log('p',p.referenceNumber,'xmm',p.x*MM_PER_INCH,'ymm',p.y*MM_PER_INCH); for(const x of cands){console.log('cand',x*MM_PER_INCH,'valid',isPlacementValid({x,y:p.y},p.width,p.height,others));}

tasks.label: runtime-sweep-compact
args: $env:OPTIMIZER_DETERMINISTIC='1'; node ./node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs -e "import { generateLayout } from './src/optimizer/layoutEngine.ts'; const seededRandom=(seed)=>{let state=seed>>>0; return ()=>{state=(1664525*state+1013904223)>>>0; return state/0x100000000;};}; const makeOrder=(count,seed)=>{const rand=seededRandom(seed); const out=[]; for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const width=24+Math.floor(rand()*26); const height=16+Math.floor(rand()*24); const orientation=rand()>0.5?'VERT':'HORI'; out.push({id:'runtime-'+count+'-'+(i+1),referenceNumber:'#'+String(i+1).padStart(3,'0'),name:'Runtime '+(i+1),width,height,orientation,color:'#64748b'});} return out;}; for (const count of [10,25,50,100]) { const t0=Date.now(); const layout=generateLayout(makeOrder(count,count*101+17)); const elapsed=Date.now()-t0; console.log('RUNTIME count='+count+' elapsedMs='+elapsed+' tables='+layout.tables.length); }"
